scoring_model.chain: raw evidence (cited, tiered) -> normalized score 0-100 per dimension -> weighted composite -> PASS/FAIL verdict
scoring_model.verdict_rule: PASS iff composite >= 70 AND every dimension >= 40 AND all 5 validation questions = YES (see market_validation.md)

CANDIDATE-A.name: BanjirSense-MY — community flood early-warning node SoC (low-power, Sub-GHz mesh)

evidence.claim: Annual flood losses RM933.4M (2024) / RM636.9M (2025); RM6.1B in 2021 exceptional event
evidence.source: DOSM via Bernama S05 (T2), DOSM S04 (T1), CNA S01 (T2)

evidence.claim: Device market sized bottom-up: 300-500k flood-prone community nodes (kampung, school, condo-basement, road-underpass) over 4 years x RM129-149 = RM40-70M TAM; SAM (urban KL/Selangor/Penang/JB + govt pilots + JPS/NADMA channel) ~100-150k units = RM13-22M
evidence.source: model from DOSM population/flood data (T1) + govt allocation RM25M East-MY repairs (T5 S42) — labeled model

evidence.claim: M40/T20 urban households (avg income RM8,479/mo 2022) can absorb RM129-149 devices

market_fit_size.rationale: Problem is quantified nationally and recurring; device market is modest but government + community co-buyers exist. Segmented: device (node) vs system (warning network) — device is our TAM.

evidence.claim: Flood losses recur every monsoon (Nov-Mar); World Bank flags rising climate-driven costs
NaFFWS national forecasting expansion = govt spending on flood sensing infrastructure 2020-2026
Community-level early warning remains coarse: area sirens (KL), no per-community low-cost sensing
RM25M 2025 federal allocation for flood-infrastructure repairs (East MY)

timing_growth.rationale: Annual news hook + rising government budgets + climate intensity make the next 4 years the window.

evidence.claim: Commercial LoRaWAN level sensors USD 234-504 — 1.5-3x above our RM150 ceiling
Low-end Alibaba sensors USD 70-415 exist (price pressure, quality variance)
Academic LoRaWAN flood sensing units for Malaysia exist (T2) but are not products
JPS/NAFFWS is basin-level, not community-level; sirens are area-level
DIY Arduino+JSN-SR04T flood projects are hobby-grade (repository.psa.edu.my thesis)

competition_gap.rationale: Gap: <RM150 community node with mesh radio + local alerting, no network subscription. Substitutes are 2-3x pricier, network-dependent, or hobby-grade.

evidence.claim: No open pure-Verilog Sub-GHz radio PHY exists (only SDR software: gr-lora_sdr, SDR-LoRa)
In-house FSK radio baseband + mesh MAC + sensor AFE on open sky130 = first open Malaysian flood-node SoC
Differentiation vs module-assembly competitors (MCU + SX1262) = single-die, solar/battery, mesh without gateway/network fees

differentiation_novelty.rationale: Meaningfully different from commercial (module-built), academic (paper-only), and open-source (none) layers.

evidence.claim: All digital blocks sky130-proven: Ibex 100MHz (IP index T1), OpenRAM 32kB (T1), AXI/AHB/APB fabrics (T1), peripherals (T1)
Analog: 12-bit SAR ADC, comparator, LDO, PLL designable on sky130
433/915MHz FSK PHY algorithms public (SDR-LoRa); sky130 RF front-end NOT silicon-proven — mitigation: external RF FE, in-house digital baseband
3-tier AMBA justified: CPU+DMA on AXI4-Lite, sensor/radio streaming on AHB, control on APB

technical_feasibility.rationale: High confidence on digital+analog core; RF front-end is the named risk with a fallback that preserves the CREATE-IP story (digital PHY).

evidence.claim: BOM model at RM129 retail: SoC RM15-18 + ultrasonic sensor RM20-30 (JSN-SR04T, Shopee T5) + battery/solar RM12-18 + PCB RM12-15 + enclosure RM15-20 + RF parts RM8-15 = RM82-116 cost; margin 15-35% — thin but survivable at volume; mesh variant drops LoRa module cost to ~RM0 (radio on-die)
Prototype USD 9,750 (chipIgnite) or free Google MPW

unit_economics.rationale: Under RM150 achievable; margin sensitive to sensor/enclosure choices — drive volume via govt pilots + community programs.

evidence.claim: CREATE: Sub-GHz FSK radio PHY + MAC (no open equivalent — S35 T2); sensor-capture DMA engine; wake-on-comparator power gating
REUSE: Ibex, pulp-axi, OpenRAM, SPI/UART/I2C, timers, PMU, interrupt ctrl (IP index T1)
Patentable angle: low-power mesh flood-alert protocol + energy-harvest node architecture

ip_ability.rationale: Highest-value IP of the three: radio PHY/MAC is portable across IoT verticals.

evidence.claim: SIRIM Type Approval mandatory for radio devices; MCMC label; 2-6 months (Mode B)
433/915MHz ISM band usable in Malaysia (SRD class)
evidence.source: S37 (T3) — confirm band plan at design time

evidence.claim: Govt ecosystem: NaFFWS expansion + NIMP 2030 semiconductor push favor local silicon

regulatory_ecosystem.rationale: Known bounded path; no medical/safety certification for non-consumer-alerting sensor nodes.

CANDIDATE-B.name: JagaCare-MY — elderly aging-in-place health & safety monitor SoC (low-power, 2.4GHz GFSK/BLE-class, on-device DSP)

evidence.claim: Malaysia ageing nation by 2030: 60+ reaches 15.3% (DOSM); 2.6M aged 65+ (7.7%) in 2024

Device market bottom-up: 3.6M aged 60+ (2026e); urban M40/T20 families with elderly parents ~1.2-1.5M households; 8-12% 4-yr adoption = 100-180k devices x RM139-149 = RM14-27M SAM; TAM with nationwide + institutional (care homes) = RM30-50M
Malaysia patient-monitoring device market USD 403M (2024) growing 6.1% CAGR — device segment context

market_fit_size.rationale: Deterministic demographics; adoption limited by trust/channel, not need.

evidence.claim: 2030 aged-nation crossing lands inside the 4-year window (2026-2030)
MOH digital health push: national FHIR HIN since 2022; digital-first healthcare policy
Elderly care is a standing national policy topic (National Policy for Older Persons; aged-nation 2048 fiscal warnings)

timing_growth.rationale: Strongest timing story of the three — the demographic clock is fixed.

evidence.claim: Substitutes: Apple/Huawei watches with fall detection (USD 200-400+), generic fall watches USD 100-200 (S18 T3), app-only check-ins (I'm Alive, CorriCare, SmartPeep — MY competitors)
No Malaysia-native <RM150 open-silicon elderly monitor device exists (market scan)
Gap: affordable, privacy-first (on-device detection, no cloud video), locally supported device

competition_gap.rationale: Gap is real but the space is crowded at the top (smartwatches) and bottom (pendants); middle is ours.

evidence.claim: CREATE: 2.4GHz GFSK baseband + link layer (BLE-class) in pure Verilog — no open equivalent (S35 T2)
On-device fall/health DSP accelerator (IMU feature extraction + PPG HR) — no cloud dependency
Open RTL + Malaysia-first positioning vs imported commodity modules

differentiation_novelty.rationale: Novel in the Malaysian context; BLE-class PHY is the moat if achieved.

evidence.claim: Digital core all proven: Ibex + OpenRAM + DMA + peripherals (IP index T1); DSP accelerator is standard Verilog (SINC/FFT/threshold)
Analog: SAR ADC for PPG path, comparator, LDO, PLL (T1/T5 baseline)
2.4GHz RF front-end on sky130 = HIGH risk, not silicon-proven; mitigation: external BLE RF FE module + in-house digital baseband/link (CREATE core preserved)
3-tier AMBA justified: CPU/DMA AXI4-Lite; ADC/IMU streaming + DSP on AHB; radio/AFE/PMU control on APB

technical_feasibility.rationale: Feasible with the RF-fallback; honest 65 because 2.4GHz analog is the hardest of the three candidates' radios.

evidence.claim: Wearable BOM at RM139 retail: SoC RM17-20 + IMU RM8-12 + PPG RM10-15 + battery RM8-10 + strap/PCB/enclosure RM20-28 = RM63-85; margin 30-45% — volume-dependent
evidence.source: T5 model; cross-check fall watches USD 100-200 (S18 T3), nRF module class (S36 T1)

evidence.claim: No medical certification if marketed as safety/monitoring (avoid MDA registration)

unit_economics.rationale: Achievable at volume; retail < RM150 tight but workable with home-hub model (hub at RM99 + wearable at RM139).

evidence.claim: CREATE: GFSK baseband/link IP + DSP accelerator + bio-AFE config engine — portable to wearables/medical IoT
REUSE: Ibex, OpenRAM, SPI (IMU), I2C (PPG), timers, PMU, watchdog (IP index T1)

ip_ability.rationale: Radio + DSP IP highly reusable; patent angle on privacy-first on-device fall detection pipeline.

evidence.claim: SIRIM Type Approval required (radio); MCMC label
MDA medical-device rules avoided by non-medical positioning — but marketing must be careful (inversion)
MOH FHIR HIN creates future data-interop pull for health devices

regulatory_ecosystem.rationale: Bounded; the medical-claims trap is the main regulatory risk and is manageable.

CANDIDATE-C.name: EVCore-MY — smart EV AC-charger controller SoC (high-performance MCU class, CAN + metering DSP + CP analog)

evidence.claim: Charging gap: 3,600 public points end-2024 vs 10,000 target end-2025; +153%/yr growth; 30% DC share
2024: 14,766 BEV + 30,796 hybrids (MAA); 46,403 xEV (MITI) — installed base growing 40-70%/yr
Home AC chargers RM2,800-7,000 installed (system market); controller module (our device) RM99-149: 4-yr TAM ~80-150k modules = RM8-22M; SAM (MY charger makers + CPOs + retrofit) ~50-80k = RM5-12M
evidence.source: S25/S26 (T4) system prices; device model labeled

market_fit_size.rationale: Device market smallest in MYR of the three but fastest-growing; rides a policy-mandated build-out.

evidence.claim: Low Carbon Mobility Blueprint + NETR (net-zero 2050, 45% GHG cut 2030) mandate charging build-out
Targets missed (3,600 vs 10,000) = the gap persists through 2026-2030
xEV sales growth 40-70%/yr makes home-charging a mass-market need in the window

timing_growth.rationale: Strong policy + market pull; window is exactly the charger build-out years.

evidence.claim: Global controller silicon: NXP/TI/ST EVSE reference designs; commodity OCPP 4G/WiFi modules (AliExpress-class) for retrofit
No Malaysia-designed open EVSE controller SoC; local charger makers import controller boards
Gap: affordable open-silicon OCPP-certifiable controller with local support, for MY charger OEMs

competition_gap.rationale: Competition is real but imported/closed; the open-silicon + local-support angle is the wedge.

evidence.claim: CREATE: CAN 2.0B controller + metrology DSP (energy accumulation, sinc filtering) + CP analog interface (PWM gen + level detect)
evidence.source: analysis; IP index has no CAN/metering entries (T1)

evidence.claim: In-house OCPP-ready stack on open RTL — first open Malaysian EVSE SoC
Differentiation vs ESP32-based boards: metering-grade ADC, CP handling, CAN, security-ready MCU in one die

differentiation_novelty.rationale: Differentiated in Malaysia; globally incremental (reference designs exist) — honest 70.

evidence.claim: No RF on-die (WiFi via external module) — the hardest RF risk is removed
All blocks sky130-proven: cv32e40p 100MHz (IP index T1), OpenRAM 64kB (T1), AXI/AHB/APB (T1), SPI/UART/I2C/PWM/timers (T1)
CAN controller + metrology DSP = standard digital Verilog; 16-bit oversampled ADC + comparator = sky130 analog (T1/T5)
3-tier AMBA justified: CPU/DMA AXI4-Lite; metering + display streaming on AHB; CP/GPIO/UART/PMU control on APB

technical_feasibility.rationale: Easiest silicon path of the three (no RF) — the highest feasibility score.

evidence.claim: Module BOM at RM139 retail: SoC RM18-22 + WiFi module RM25-35 (ESP32-class, pre-certified) + power RM10-15 + PCB RM12-18 + relay/CT RM10-15 = RM75-105; margin 25-45%
Retrofit market (OCPP modules) price-anchors the device: commodity 4G/WiFi OCPP modules sell at RM150-300 — we undercut with local silicon

unit_economics.rationale: Workable; WiFi module cost squeezes margin — BLE/Sub-GHz in-house variant improves it later.

evidence.claim: CREATE: CAN 2.0B (no open Verilog-2001 CAN in IP index — T1), metrology DSP, CP analog; REUSE: CPU/fabric/mem/periph (T1)
Metering + EVSE control IP reusable in smart meters, solar inverters, industrial control

ip_ability.rationale: Strong reusable digital IP; CAN + metrology have wide secondary markets.

evidence.claim: EVSE standard: MS IEC 61851 (Type 2, CP signaling); OCPP 1.6/2.0.1 conformance (OCA)
SIRIM: WiFi module pre-certified; charger needs SIRIM/ST certification — local OEM channel handles it
NIMP 2030/NSS: local EVSE silicon aligns with national semiconductor strategy

regulatory_ecosystem.rationale: Clear path via local OEM partners; legal metrology avoided (no billing-grade claims).

ranking.winner_rationale: A wins on the owner's core axes: strongest Malaysia-specific unsolved problem (recurring floods, RM0.6-6B/yr losses), cleanest CREATE-wireless-in-house claim (Sub-GHz FSK ≪ 2.4GHz BLE complexity), credible govt/community co-buyer channel, and the deepest IP-ability. C is a close second with the best silicon feasibility; B trails on feasibility and crowded competition. All three PASS the bottom-to-top threshold; the verdict is derivable from the JSON.
